body.name: Contact radius and padded grid field
body.construction: Define \(R_{\mathrm c}(x)\) as the least symmetric radius containing the support of \(\mathfrak g-\mathfrak g_x^0\). At level \(u\), truncate contacts and pad simulations by \(R(u)=u^2\). At horizons \(T\ge T_0\), compute \(D_T^{\mathrm{pad}}\) from finite-window GCMs on \([-R(b(T)),T+R(b(T))]\) and evaluate it on the mesh \(\Delta(b(T))\mathbb Z\cap[0,T]\).
